cards.hint: Recall the first guiding question about the planet.
cards.quote: Earth is about 4.6 billion years old?
cards.stem: What numeric age have geologists determined for Earth?

cards.hint: Think about rocks holding the earliest known fossils.
cards.quote: The oldest known fossils are from rocks that were deposited about 3.5 billion years ago?
cards.stem: When were the rocks with the oldest known fossils deposited?

cards.hint: Think about shelly fossils in younger rocks.
cards.quote: The first abundant shelly fossils occur in rocks that are about 570 million years old?
cards.stem: When do the first abundant shelly fossils occur in rocks?

cards.hint: Think about the end of cold glacial time.
cards.quote: The last ice age ended about 10,000 ago?
cards.stem: When did the last ice age end?
